title: Le site StudyTrack : choisis le monde visuel
question: Le tirage a assigné « Musica Viva ». Garde-le, prends l'alternative, ou relance.

options.label: Musica Viva
options.lineage: Swiss International Typographic Style, Müller-Brockmann's Zürich concert posters, 1950s–70s
options.thesis: Moodle's chaos assembling, in live 3D, into one strict Swiss grid: your semester, rangé.
materials: WebGL geometry on a modular grid
options.viewport: Black field; floating PDFs, videos and series tiles drift in 3D, then snap into a 14-week × course grid as you scroll, beside a giant grotesk « Moodle, enfin rangé. » and three download buttons (iPhone, Mac, Windows).
options.risk: Swiss Style is a famous school: set timidly it reads as a design-student homage, so the grid and the type must be brutally large.

raised.raise: One colour reserved for 'en retard', like the only red past zero on a VU meter; nothing else may use it.
Depth encodes rank in the 3D scene: what matters this week sits frontmost and brightest, the rest recedes.
The scroll is one lighting cue: the field moves from night (exam crunch) to day (rangé), labelled, never colour alone.

options.label: Rolex Learning Center
options.lineage: SANAA's undulating slab on the EPFL campus
options.thesis: Your semester as the Rolex Center's floor: a white undulating 3D slab whose hills are your heavy weeks.
options.viewport: A white wavy slab in WebGL, 14 bays for 14 weeks, circular patios cut where deadlines fall, the headline floating in the light.
options.risk: Instantly recognisable on campus, but the most literal reading of EPFL; white-on-white can feel cold and corporate.

options.label: VU-meter bridge
options.thesis: Honest hours as needles leaning into the red together.
options.viewport: A row of course meters reading this week's hours.
options.risk: Students don't identify with a mixing desk.
options.case: Fuses: hours map to needles, but loses on audience and clarity.

options.label: Cracktro scroller
options.viewport: One ivory line over three drifting layers.

options.label: Cyclorama dawn
options.thesis: Night to day as a lighting cue.
options.viewport: Horizon bands rising from black to day.
options.kept: The scroll as one labelled light cue.

options.label: Treasure map
options.risk: Hides the offer behind a puzzle.

options.label: Parametric identity
options.thesis: A seed-driven mark restyling the page.
options.viewport: A live mark with a reseed panel.
options.risk: About the brand, not the student.

options.label: Sneaker box wall
options.thesis: Boxes slid out of a stack.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished app landing: phone mockups, feature rows, gradient glow.
canonCard.viewport: Headline left, tilted phone right, feature grid below.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every app site by design.
